_note: Published measured values used by meas_check2.py (round 3, D13). Each entry quotes its source; see sim/data/README.md.

zenith.ref: Archibald et al. 2002, MNRAS 336, 1, Table 1, 450W:850W filters (DOI 10.1046/j.1365-8711.2002.05582.x)
zenith.band_note: SCUBA filter widths are not tabulated; the SCUBA-2 half-power bands (Holland et al. 2013) are used as a proxy

zenith.ref: Dempsey et al. 2013, MNRAS 430, 2534, Sec. 3.2 (DOI 10.1093/mnras/stt090); bands: Holland et al. 2013, MNRAS 430, 2513, Sec. 2

pwv.ref: Chamberlin, Lane and Stark 1997, ApJ 476, 428, Table 2, LO 493.66 GHz (DOI 10.1086/303621)
pwv.profile_note: the data are from days 137 to 321 (austral winter and spring), so the P.835-6 high-latitude winter profile is used

horizontal.ref: Yang, Mandehgar and Grischkowsky 2014, Opt. Express 22, 4388, p. 4390 and p. 4399 (DOI 10.1364/OE.22.004388)
horizontal.note: water-vapor absorption of 7.0 g/m3 (cross term removed), 137 m path; window minima quoted at 9.3 g/m3 after scaling by 1.33, divided back here
horizontal.err_note: No uncertainty is stated for the attenuation values; the only stated accuracy is the vapor density along the path, 0.04 g/m3 (about RH 2%), from the 0.1 ps transit-time accuracy (p. 4395 of the paper).

horizontal.ref: Yang, Shutler and Grischkowsky 2011, Opt. Express 19, 8830, Table 1 (DOI 10.1364/OE.19.008830)
horizontal.note: 6.18 m path, repeatability +-0.5 % in amplitude (about +-7 dB/km); pressure not stated (1004 hPa assumed); superseded by yang2014
